children: The final leg of the results season will see multiple state-run companies report their numbers during the course of the day. Before that, stocks like Hindustan Copper, Tata Power, MIDHANI, and others will be reacting to their numbers today that were reported after market hours. Action Construction Equipment, Alkem Laboratories, Astra Micro, Bharat Dynamics, Shivalik Bimetal, Bondada Engineering, Caplin Point, Concord Biotech, GIC Housing, Hindustan Aeronautics, Hawkins cooker, Vodafone Idea, IFCI, IRCTC, Landmark Cars, Manappuram Finance, MSTC, Nava, NMDC, Oil India, Page Industries, Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Healthcare, Hitachi Energy India, RCF, Seshasayee Industries, TD Power, Travel Food Solutions, Turtlemint, VIP Industries, Yatra Online are some of the major results during the course of the day. Focus will also be on Vodafone Idea's commentary on any potential progress on the debt fund raising plan.
Watch this space for all the live Q2 results updates, management commentary and brokerage views.

title: Q2 Results Live Updates: HAL, Page, Vodafone Idea close out earnings season; Tata Power reacts
